t: An open source classroom robot with a 3D-printed body and Arduino controller.
steps: Find the Barnabas-Bot project page and read the instructor guide.
Decide on the quick-build or the full class version.
Print or obtain the body parts and the Barnabas Noggin.
Gather three 9g servos, a buzzer and an LED.
Install the Arduino IDE on a computer.
Assemble one robot as a test.
Program a first move in the Arduino IDE or in ArduBlock.
